propositions: Documentation for the optional S3 backend must be added to docs/config.md to explain that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix URLs served by the git-remote-s3 helper

A new operator guide at docs/s3-backend.md must document installation, SSE-KMS bucket setup with IAM/CMK, git remote configuration, credentials/encryption trust boundary, and auto-doctor self-heal behavior for stale locks

An ADR at docs/adr/0093-s3-ticket-store-backend.md must record the architectural decision to use git-remote-s3, justify SSE-KMS encryption, explain the merge-based auto-doctor rationale, and document the rejected TTL-lowering
The ADR infrastructure (per-number marker docs/adr/.numbers/0093 and regenerated index docs/adr/README.md) must be generated via scripts/gen_adr_index.py and validated by scripts/check_adr_numbers.py
Both new documentation pages must be discoverable from docs/README.md with the new backend page linked directly and the ADR discoverable through the generated ADR index
